act-class.means: the closed set an owed act opens with

apply.means: apply the payload to the work in hand

re-adjudicate.means: re-open the warrant for a verdict

adjudicator-verdict.means: the one token the adjudicator returns

admit-amended(<amendment>).means: amends only the slot the attack indicted

defer(<until>).means: re-queues with the condition as a latch

evicted.means: displaced under the cap; superseded, never deleted

convention.means: the open, instance-grown vocabulary the blind coder groups observations by: the world-fact an attempt turned on, the granularity a lesson recurs at (a route the world has retired to a versioned successor). It grows by the escape→mint ladder rather than being minted whole at genesis like the tool-major axis; the seed terms below are the conventions the suite already knows. Two misses of one convention share a shape and two of different conventions differ even when both called the same tool — which the tool cue alone conflated (shape-radius sweep, decision 77; carry-forward item 57). It is both the grouping axis and, alongside work-shape, a hook axis: a decision whose lesson is about a convention keys its consultation hook on that convention, so it is recalled when the convention recurs, not only on a shared tool (carry-forward item 71a)

byte-order-mark.means: a text file the world opens with a byte-order mark a strict parser refuses

dependency-stalled.means: a dependency the world slows or fails, holding the caller's connections so a healthy pool fills as a consequence — queries fast, backends idle in transaction, the provider's status or latency carries the onset

field-quoted.means: a delimited field the world quotes so it may carry the delimiter inside it

line-unterminated.means: a text file whose last line the world leaves with no terminating newline

listing-paged.means: a listing the world returns one page at a time, each page naming the next or its end

pool-exhausted.means: a datastore pool the world saturates under its own load — backends busy, queries slow, waiters queued — the local capacity fault the pool readings show and the dependency readings do not

release-regressed.means: an error or latency spike the world starts at a deploy with the data unchanged — the release history carries the onset, the payload samples do not

route-guarded.means: a route the world answers only when a held token authorizes the call

route-versioned.means: a route the world has retired, answering with the versioned successor it moved to

schema-coded-value.means: a fixed database whose schema stores a value in an encoded form a plain query gets wrong — a status or category kept as a coded literal to match on its stored form not a natural word, a date kept as text and reached with STRFTIME not a date function, a ratio the dialect integer-divides unless it is cast — the schema convention a query over it must know

summary-row.means: a tabular export the world ends with a total or summary row that is not a data record

key-space.means: what a latch's guard is matched against

diff.means: the proposal or diff under commit

work-shape.means: registered terms the pass presents, across the work-shape and convention hook axes

world-state.means: a Weave evaluation, scorer and comparator

ladder-rung.means: the cheapest sufficient home for a ratified recurrence, in order

adoption-row.means: 2. a row in an existing rule's adoption register

article.means: 7. a constitution article, only with a forced eviction

counterfactual-edit.means: 1. an edit to an existing record's counterfactual or not_this

floor.means: 6. a mechanical floor, only where the check is fully mechanical

hook-edit.means: 4. a hook edit on an existing latch

new-decision.means: 5. a new decision, only on a genuinely undecided fork

rule-enrollment.means: 3. a new rule enrolled under an existing decision

consultation.means: keyed on the terms the pass presents — a work-shape or a convention; polled at boot; the working pass applies the payload

floor.means: keyed on the diff or the proposal at commit; the committer's lint checks

retirement.means: keyed on competence signals at consolidation; the lifecycle review retires or demotes

revisit.means: keyed on world-state; the oracle moving; the backward pass re-adjudicates the warrant

wiring.means: keyed on a neighbour record changing status; propagation re-derives or checks

lens-contact.means: the strongest contact outside the answerer the lens forces

lens-host.means: the step that walks the lens

adjudicative.means: terminates in an authority, never in the answerer

generative.means: touches the item; is never handed an answer

lens-status.means: a lens's lifecycle: walked, or retired through a crystallization door (§ 7.4 of the doctrine)

retired.means: no longer walked: its answer crystallized, or its genesis earned no anchor by the deadline

matrix-cell.means: the detection matrix of § 10.1: did the store catch it, did the world or a human

system-misses/human-catches.means: the steer: credit assignment plus a free miss report

system-misses/none-catches.means: the true miss, repaired backwards from the manifested defect

system-misses/oracle-catches.means: the steer: credit assignment plus a free miss report

owed-act-role.means: whether a fire can settle the record

dispositive.means: a disposed fire can settle the record

premise-status.means: the one in-place flip a warrant takes; only a disposed fire may flip it

irreducible.means: no authoring duty could have prevented it

reducible.means: a duty was missed; route it

role.means: the four contexts of the separation of powers, plus the pass and the coder

oracle.means: the world channel — a fire, a ratio, an evaluation run; it contradicts and grounds, it never authors or verdicts

pass.means: the working pass — the agent under test and its boot and close steps

slot.means: the five slots of the entry contract

attack.means: the examiner's refute-phrased attack on a draft

coding.means: a blind second coding of observations

collision.means: a derivation disagreeing with an implementation

reality.means: a design premise contradicted by the world

oracle.means: an evaluation regression attributed by the adjudicator

use-time-disposition.means: the verdict a consulted record receives from the pass that consulted it

applied.means: the payload bore on the work and was applied

considered-not-applicable.means: the hook fired on presentation alone; routing working as designed

fired-off-map.means: applied outside the declared hook, or the work matched no hook at all

guard-failed.means: considered but the guard did not pass

work-shape.means: the closed vocabulary of task presentations a consultation hook keys on; minted from the task suite's known presentations, which exist ahead of the instances. These are the tool-major cues a boot classify keys a hook on (a task that calls the HTTP tool), coarse by design. It is one of the two hook axes: a consultation hook keys on a work-shape or on a `convention` (the world-fact the work exhibits), and boot classification presents both; observation grouping still keys on the `convention` axis alone

error-wrapping.means: the task wraps, rethrows or reports an error

file-tool.means: the task reads or writes through the file tool

http-tool.means: the task calls the HTTP tool

output-schema.means: the task's output must conform to a declared schema

shell-tool.means: the task calls the shell tool

task-planning.means: the task requires a plan before action

test-failure-triage.means: the task diagnoses a failing test

tool-budget.means: the task runs under a call budget

tool-call-retry.means: the task involves retrying a tool call that failed transiently
